div.div:
صَوْلَةٌ is an inf. n.: (S, O, K: [see 1, first sentence:]) or it signifies A leap, or spring: (TA:) or a single act of a camel's leaping, or springing, upon [other] camels, and fighting them; as also ↓ صِيَالَةٌ : (Msb:) [but more commonly, impetuosity, of a man, and of a camel or the like.] ―
-b2- [Hence,] ذُو صَوْلَةٍ فِى المِزْوَدِ One who springs upon the food, and devours it immoderately. (M, TA. *) ―
-b3- لَقِيتُهُ أَوَّلَ صَوْلَةٍ means أَوَّلَ وَهْلَةٍ [i. e. I met him the first thing, or the first thing that I saw]. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
